title: Google Maps Issues: Billing Errors
text:
## Google Maps Issues: Billing Errors
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000057688
CHECK ERROR CODE: Google Maps Issues: Index
If Google Maps locations aren't loading on the homepage or search modules even though the Initial Set Up Steps have been completed, it's most likely because the site is missing the billing information.
Next Steps:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12073724718/original/sJZrPjNmIF-yYKnBWWJJWfo6UQkpUtqvPA.png?1581203345 | alt: ]
2. From there select "Billing":
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12073724732/original/fsHcpJ1ICsPcSt9gE3BkeoHHD3Rw58L6Tg.png?1581203406 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12073724735/original/OdpPWktBbaNG4eeXumzfbnqXVfyro5gCBg.png?1581203463 | alt: ]
